title: Walchsee Kaiserwinkl
highlights: Expansive natural swimming lake boasting warm water temperatures of up to 24°C
Thriving water sports center offering waterskiing, electric boats, and sailing
Exciting Wibit inflatable water park with water trampolines and climbing icebergs
Peaceful lakeside promenade affording open views of the Zahmer Kaiser mountains
kurzbeschreibung: Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl is a warm, spacious swimming lake featuring water skiing, an aqua park, and panoramic Kaiser views.
beschreibung:
Bathing Pleasures and Water Sports in the Kaiserwinkl

Covering approximately 100 hectares, Walchsee lies at an altitude of 658 metres at the northern foot of the Zahmer Kaiser. Thanks to its sheltered basin setting, it is among the warmest swimming lakes in Tirol, reaching summer water temperatures of up to 24 degrees Celsius.

Active Holidays along the Shoreline

The lakeshore features well-tended lidos with expansive sunbathing lawns, an inflatable Wibit water fun park for children, boat rentals, and Tirol's only waterskiing school on a natural lake. The flat lakeside circular path is ideal for relaxed walks and bicycle rides set against a spectacular alpine backdrop.
